title: Toji Fushiguro Core Hypertrophy Training
author: AestheticHypertrophy
desc: This is a bit of core training you can do nightly that compliments the training you did earlier in the day. The program it compliments is one that I have already created. Feel free to use that routine. It is posted for everyone to see. The goal of these workouts is to train the abs through hypertrophy focused techniques. Some objectors may argue that you’ll get a blocky waist but I argue that like most of your training it is impossible to accidentally get too big without the use of PEDs. This program will not only strengthen your core but it will also aid in having a core that can be visible despite a higher body fat percentage. This will enable you to not obsess over being 12% body fat.

ss.note: Make sure to turn your whole body to one side instead of just your shoulders and arms. Also, maintain around a 25 degree angle from the ground.
Try making it more of a weighted sit-up. Avoid hitting the ground too hard on the eccentric. Above all else, focus on the eccentric lowering portion of the movement to stimulate hypertrophy.

ex.note:
If you can go beyond 15 reps then do AMRAP.
Once you can do it without that much effort you can find a way to make it weighted or you can change the tempo. You also try using a band.
